prompts.name: mouth_closed
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. You are making isolated animation mouth layers for the exact cute Nihao Agent 2D pixel-art girl in the reference. Deliver ONE MOUTH ONLY, centered on a genuinely transparent PNG canvas, no face, skin, head, nose, hair, cheeks, eyes, neck, labels or other object. Match the reference's very simple stepped pixel style and dark brown mouth color. Use crisp square pixel clusters, hard stair-step contours, a small curated palette of dark chocolate outline/interior and soft salmon-pink tongue only when appropriate. No realistic lips, lipstick, gradients, antialiasing, smooth curves, white background, checkerboard, or shadows. Keep the mouth front-facing, symmetrical, stylized and friendly. The mouth spans about 35% of canvas width, with plenty of transparent margin so it can be cropped and placed as a facial layer.
Variant: CLOSED NEUTRAL. A slim closed mouth with a very slight gentle upward curve, exactly like the tiny mouth of the supplied reference character but calmer. Dark brown only, no inner opening, no teeth, no tongue. One single isolated mouth shape.
